objective: Fix portrait uploads and show failed upload messages beside the file picker
cause: Production melodio-private bucket lacked image/jpeg in its MIME allowlist; server normalizes all portraits to JPEG. A normal upload failure leaves portrait null. Upload errors previously appeared only below the complete editor.
storageFix: Permit image/jpeg while preserving private access, existing audio/JSON types, byte limits and policies. Verify real synthetic signed portrait storage and readback before marking complete.
uiFix: Scoped upload error next to file picker; cleared on retry, switching artist/account and server reload. Successful portrait response keeps current private preview flow.
